tokens.title: API access
tokens.intro: Let ChatGPT, Claude or another tool read your workouts, history and bodyweight — to review your training or spot a stall — and, with a read and write token, rework your workouts and week for you. Changes reach your phone on its next sync; logged sets are never changed. Anyone holding a token has that access, so revoke it when you stop using it.
tokens.chatgptHow: Configure → Create new action → Import from URL, and paste the schema address below. Authentication: API key, Bearer, with your token.
tokens.scriptsHow: Create a token and copy the prompt shown with it, or send the header yourself:
tokens.endpoints: Read: /profile, /workouts, /exercises, /history, /bodyweight. Write: create, replace and delete workouts, set /programme/week, record bodyweight. Weights are in kg.

create.writeDetail: Also edit workouts, your week and bodyweight
create.copyNow: Copy it now — it will not be shown again.
create.pastePrompt: Or paste this into an assistant that can make web requests:

errors.badScope: Choose read only or read and write.
errors.tooMany: You have {max} tokens. Revoke one first.
